column1: # Applied to GfxEngine.dll before it is translated (tools/lift_all.sh passes this file to the lifter).
# Screen mode 4 of the game (Screenmode = 4 in Config/GameSettings.cfg) is 1600x1200 in the original; here it is 1920x1080.
# The engine renders any size with the layout of the 1280x1024 mode, so the map view just gets bigger.
# the size the engine sets up for mode 4: mov ebp,640h / mov ebx,4B0h
# the check whether DirectDraw offers the mode (two copies): cmp ecx,640h / cmp dword ptr [eax+8],4B0h
